name: Deluin's Arctic command post
about: Where Deluin sits during the battle of chapters 29 and 30. The book never places him (adaptations/dog-dawn/brief.md, section 2); it says only what is listed below. Everything else, the room, its glass wall and the sentries beyond it, is invented for the dog-dawn adaptation, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.fact: He is watched while he works.

facts.quote: if I can see it, the sentries might be able to as well
facts.fact: There are sentries who can see what his systems see.

descriptor: a narrow Arctic command room walled in pale faceted crystalline panels, a single sleek console with a glowing screen and one chair, and across the back of the room a wall of frosted glass with a dim corridor beyond it
plate_prompt: Establishing view of a narrow Arctic command room walled in pale faceted crystalline panels, a single sleek console with a glowing screen and one chair, and across the back of the room a wall of frosted glass with a dim corridor beyond it. Seen from just inside the doorway at night, lit only by the cold blue glow of the screen; a tall side window shows a black starry sky. No people.
